"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Aggressive efforts to cut costs and eliminate waste from the health system will save the typical family up to $2,500 per year.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Driving adoption of state-of-the-art health information technology systems, privacy-protected electronic medical records, reimbursement incentives, and an independent organization reviewing drugs, devices, and procedures will advance a modernized health system.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Improving quality of care will reduce the prevalence of lawsuits related to medical errors.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Competition in the insurance and drug markets should be increased.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Some of the cost burden of catastrophic illness should be removed from employers and their employees.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Drug costs should be lowered by allowing Medicare to negotiate for lower prices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Drug costs should be lowered by permitting importation of safe medicines from other developed countries.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Drug costs should be lowered by creating a generic pathway for biologic drugs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The use of generics should be increased in public programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
